prompt: You run a program in IntelliJ with the Debug button. A red dot appears next to line 7. What does that dot mean?
code:
// line 7 of Main.java:
System.out.println("Hello");  // <-- red filled circle in gutter
answer: An active breakpoint is set at line 7
explanation: A filled red circle in the gutter is a breakpoint marker. The program will pause before executing that line when run in debug mode.
